title: Pinnacle Food Group Limited Completes First Bench-Scale Fermentation of Recombinant Human Lactoferrin (rhLF) Using Methanol-Free Pichia Fermentation
summary: Pinnacle Food Inc., based in Vancouver, BC, Canada, is a revolutionary company in the world of agriculture that is making vertical farming and hydroponics easy and accessible to everyone.
body_markdown:
***rhLF expression from the Company's first-generation yeast strain confirmed in a 5-liter bench-scale fermenter; milestone supports further strain optimization and scale-up evaluation***


**VANCOUVER, BC AND HONG KONG, HK /[ACCESS Newswire](https://www.accessnewswire.com/) / October 13, 2026 /** Pinnacle Food Group Limited (NASDAQ:PFAI) ("Pinnacle Food" or the "Company"), a technology-driven company operating at the intersection of smart farming and bioengineering, today announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, Pinnacle Food AgTech HK Limited ("PFHK"), has successfully completed the first bench-scale fermentation of the Company's first-generation recombinant human lactoferrin ("rhLF") yeast strain in a 5-liter bench-scale fermenter.


Laboratory analyses, including high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), sodium dodecyl sulfate-polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis (SDS-PAGE) and Immuno Blotting, confirmed rhLF expression. The fermentation was conducted using the methanol-free Pichia fermentation technology developed under the Company's research collaboration with Bioboost Synbio Consulting Inc. ("Bioboost"). This methanol-free approach is designed to offer a cleaner, safer and more cost-effective alternative to conventional methanol-based fermentation approaches.


The milestone builds on the Company's April 2026 announcement of the creation of its first-generation rhLF yeast strain and marks the first evaluation of that strain under controlled bench-scale fermentation conditions. The results further inform strain optimization and process development, and support the Company's evaluation of potential scale-up.


"Completing our first bench-scale fermentation and confirming rhLF expression is an important step for our biotech program," said Jiulong You, Chief Executive Officer of Pinnacle Food Group Limited. "This result gives our team a solid foundation for the next phase of work as we evaluate the path toward scale-up. We remain focused on building our precision fermentation capabilities to support the development of high-value biological ingredients for potential industry partners."


Lactoferrin is an iron-binding glycoprotein naturally present in milk, including human milk, and is used as an ingredient in infant nutrition, dietary supplements and other nutritional applications. Recombinant human lactoferrin (rhLF) that is produced through precision fermentation is intended to be structurally similar to the lactoferrin found in human milk.


**About Pinnacle Food Group Limited**


Pinnacle Food Group Limited (NASDAQ:PFAI) is a technology-driven company operating at the intersection of smart farming and bioengineering. Through its "Dual-Engine" strategy, the Company seeks to combine controlled-environment agricultural technologies with precision fermentation, synthetic biology and related engineering capabilities to support the development and commercialization of high-value biological products. For more information, please visit the Company's website at[www.pinnaclefoodinc.com](https://pr.report/sbhi) .


**About Bioboost Synbio Consulting Inc.**


Bioboost Synbio Consulting Inc. is a biotechnology consulting company based in Vancouver, Canada. In January 2026, Bioboost entered into a research and technology collaboration agreement with Pinnacle Food AgTech HK Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Pinnacle Food Group Limited, to collaborate on biotechnology and precision fermentation research applications, including research activities related to recombinant human lactoferrin (rhLF). The collaboration also includes technical consulting services, ecosystem scouting, and the evaluation of research directions and technical feasibility.
